SELECT SEQ_MOVE_CHECKLIST.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TBL_MOVE_CHECKLIST (CHECK_ID, MEMBER_ID, REQUEST_ID, ITEM_CODE, PHASE, TITLE, DONE_YN, CREATED_AT, DONE_AT) VALUES (#{checkId}, #{memberId}, #{requestId}, #{itemCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{phase}, #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{doneYn}, SYSDATE, CASE WHEN #{doneYn} = 'Y' THEN SYSDATE END)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TBL_MOVE_CHECKLIST WHERE CHECK_ID = #{checkId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND ITEM_CODE IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TBL_CHECKLIST_ITEM ORDER BY PHASE, SORT_NO, ITEM_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_CHECKLIST_ITEM (ITEM_CODE, PHASE, TITLE, DETAIL, WHERE_TEXT, LINK_URL, SORT_NO, USE_YN, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{itemCode}, #{phase}, #{title}, #{detail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{whereText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{linkUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sortNo}, #{useYn}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_CHECKLIST_ITEM SET PHASE = #{phase}, TITLE = #{title}, DETAIL = #{detail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, WHERE_TEXT = #{whereText,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LINK_URL = #{linkUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SORT_NO = #{sortNo}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ITEM_CODE = #{itemCode}
UPDATE TBL_CHECKLIST_ITEM SET USE_YN = #{use}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ITEM_CODE = #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT c.MEMBER_ID, m.MEMBER_NAME, m.PHONE, MAX(NVL(c.DONE_AT, c.CREATED_AT)) AS LAST_AT FROM TBL_MOVE_CHECKLIST c JOIN TBL_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = c.MEMBER_ID GROUP BY c.MEMBER_ID, m.MEMBER_NAME, m.PHONE ORDER BY LAST_AT DESC
